title: Rc Capabilities
objective: Implement a machine-readable release capability and provenance report that distinguishes compiled, bundled, fallback, unavailable, cold, and warm state without triggering builds.

handoff.summary: Added a standalone stable runtime observation report with deterministic JSON serialization and concise human output. Static generated FFI and production-kernel evidence is reported only as a candidate: loadability and selection remain explicitly not-probed, and SAGEJS_NATIVE_DISABLE plus MODE/AUTOLOAD/REQUIRED/WARN settings are separately described as @native runtime policy. A production-kernel candidate requires the complete declared production set with valid records, wrappers, and addons; missing or partial caches retain only their same-source fallback candidate. Mutable checkout/package/host observations are separate from immutable artifact identity, which requires an explicit valid build manifest or a verified embedded build-manifest asset. Embedded FFI manifests are checked against embedded addon bytes, source adapters are hash-checked without loading, nearby SEA checkout state is ignored, and cache paths are redacted by default. Ten focused tests cover these boundaries, including actual native-disable semantics, other @native policy combinations, incomplete kernels, tampering, valid and invalid SEA identity, explicit package identity, Windows M4RI, privacy, and read-only behavior.
risks: Exact runtime-selected native-math fingerprints require compiler/toolchain probes, so this observational report labels the runtime selection probe not-run and only compares the effective requested profile with an observed immutable build or installed-prefix profile.
Platform behavior is simulated in the focused corpus; integration should exercise the standalone report inside real Linux and macOS release artifacts.
The full portable tier currently also needs native dependencies materialized in this isolated worktree.
next_steps: The integration lane must register test/release-capabilities.cjs in test/node-test-manifest.cjs, which is outside this lane's claims, then run the portable tier with its native dependencies materialized.
Wire collectReleaseCapabilities and formatReleaseCapabilities into the public release diagnostics command without changing their observational-only contract.
Generate and embed sagejs.release-build-manifest-v1, then run the report from clean npm and SEA artifacts and retain its JSON beside release checksums and provenance.
